integrity: Entire infinite-family ranking is proved analytically by concavity and trigonometric identities; numerical exhaustive checks are supplemental; originality is provisional relative to inaccessible sources.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns vertex-supported triangles of regular triple-order polygons, m>=3, and the first four distinct area levels only. Other polygon orders, continuously movable vertices, and the complete area spectrum are outside scope. Zenodo historical priority unresolved.
title: Four exact top triangle-area shells in regular \(3m\)-gons and a cubic near-tie
